title: Member-access dot was missing from the shared columns
symptom: Array.from and rows.filter could receive call-parenthesis alignment while their member-access dots stayed in different columns.

rootCause.summary: The first call-envelope implementation treated the complete callee as one opaque cell. It declared opening and closing parentheses but no member-access dot axis.

requestedOutcome: For supported member calls, expose the terminal member-access dot as a shared boundary, as in Array.from and rows .filter, and explain unsupported cases in the skill contract.
decisions: A callee can contain meaningful syntax boundaries before its outer parentheses.
Scope the initial dot rule to supported terminal member access; optional/computed chains and comments need explicit exclusions.
Record unsupported coverage separately from a passing checker result.
